hook.say: Which country has more people? Size on the map tells you nothing. Five duels, three seconds each!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which has more people: Germany or Vietnam?
questions.fact: Vietnam: about 102 million people. Germany: about 84 million (UN, 2026).
questions.sayAnswer: Vietnam! It has about one hundred and two million people. Germany has about eighty-four million.

questions.q: Which has more people: Mexico or Japan?
questions.fact: Mexico has about 133 million people, Japan about 122 million (UN, 2026).
questions.sayAnswer: Mexico! It has about one hundred and thirty-three million people. Japan has about one hundred and twenty-two million.

questions.q: Which has more people: Italy or South Africa?
questions.fact: South Africa: about 65 million people. Italy: about 59 million (UN, 2026).
questions.sayAnswer: South Africa! It has about sixty-five million people. Italy has about fifty-nine million.

questions.q: Which has more people: Madagascar or Australia?
questions.fact: Madagascar: about 33.5 million people. Australia: about 27 million (2026).
questions.sayAnswer: Madagascar! It has about thirty-three and a half million people. Australia has about twenty-seven million.

questions.q: Which has more people: Russia or Bangladesh?
questions.fact: Bangladesh: 178 million people on under 1% of Russia's land (UN, 2026).
questions.sayAnswer: Bangladesh! It has one hundred and seventy-eight million people, on less than one percent of Russia's land.
